manual.jn1.page.0:
LABORATORY
MANUAL

Issued to control group J.N-1.

1. Terminal
2. Shop
3. Companions
4. Notes, screens
5. Lights
6. Elevator
7. Radio
8. Rifts
9. Void suit
manual.jn1.page.1:
1. THE TERMINAL

Right-click to sit at it. The Start menu leads everywhere: Spawn.exe, Shop.exe, Companions.exe, Radio.exe.

Payment is in emeralds, taken from your inventory.
manual.jn1.page.10:
9. THE VOID SUIT

Kept in the sites' locker room. Worn in full:

Forward: where you look
Jump: rise
Sneak: sink
Sprint: faster

The lidar finds the labs. To leave, dive.

manual.jn1.page.2:
2. THE SHOP

Shop.exe sells terminals, capsules and supplies.

The vending machine goes anywhere but sells less: no terminal, no capsule.

Some goods are only found within the void.
manual.jn1.page.3:
3. COMPANIONS

Acquire them in Companions.exe, bring them out with Spawn.exe.

The capsule carries them. Their affection grows with gifts: gold, emeralds, diamonds.
manual.jn1.page.4:
4. NOTES AND SCREENS

Right-click a note to write on it; "Lock" freezes it.

Wall screens are written the same way. Placed side by side, they become one. A line starting with > changes colour.
manual.jn1.page.5:
5. LIGHTS

Neon tubes, ceiling lights, wall lamps: on floors, walls or ceilings.

Right-click to switch them on or off.

Neon tubes come in seven colours.
manual.jn1.page.6:
6. THE ELEVATOR

A one-block shaft. On each floor, a landing set in the wall beside the opening, at eye level.

One click calls the cabin; another picks the floor.
manual.jn1.page.7:
THE ELEVATOR (cont.)

A landing renamed on an anvil names its floor.

Getting off mid-way stops the cabin: you stay on its floor, and clicking it reopens the panel.
manual.jn1.page.8:
7. RADIO.EXE

The terminal plays a station for the whole room, even after you leave it.


8. RIFTS

They stand in containment sites, above a breach that cannot be closed. They lead to the void.
manual.jn1.page.9:
RIFTS (cont.)

You come out in the open void, in line with the rift. Unprotected, you fall, and the void spits you back out, hurt.

Do not approach a breach without the suit: it contaminates. The airlock shower washes it off.

notebook.jn1.cover:
LABORATORY GUIDE


J.N-1 Laboratory



Everything you need to know, and nothing more.
notebook.jn1.lab.0:
FINDING IT

A house with a cellar door: the door opens onto the void.

A containment site: a fenced guard post. Below it, the lab, FapGPT and the breach.
notebook.jn1.lab.1:
THE TERMINAL

Iron, a glass pane, redstone, a daylight detector. Sit at it: Shop.exe, Companions.exe, Spawn.exe. Pay in emeralds.
notebook.jn1.lab.2:
FAPGPT

The lab's AI waits in the containment sites, above her projector, and never leaves it. Talk to her, hug her, ask her anything.
notebook.jn1.lab.3:
VENDING MACHINE

Place it anywhere. It sells the small things; the terminal also has the camera, the capsule and the terminal itself.
notebook.jn1.lab.4:
ONLYFAPS

At the terminal, OnlyFaps.exe sells your photos for emeralds. Outfit, scene, traces, cuffs and framing raise the price. Each photo sells once.
notebook.jn1.girls.1:
CALLING THEM

Unlocked in Companions.exe, called with Spawn.exe. The capsule carries any creature: throw it to catch, throw it again to release. It takes her colors.
notebook.jn1.girls.3:
AFFECTION

It grows with gifts: diamonds, emeralds, gold, ender pearls, and anything made of cum.

At 5, the hug. At 10, outfits. From 12 to 18, what you can ask her for; at 20, roughly.
notebook.jn1.girls.4:
HER MENU

Right-click with an empty hand: Talk, Ask for…, Hug, Outfit, her bag, Follow me.

Sneak + right-click: she follows you, or stays put.

A name tag renames her.
notebook.jn1.girls.5:
TALK

Chat, joke, compliment, flirt, tease, kiss. Each girl has her tastes, and her mood shifts the odds.

Success: a better mood, sometimes affection, three a day. Failure: only her mood.
notebook.jn1.scenes.1:
ASKING

"Ask for…" in her menu: the scenes her affection allows. Forward: faster. Back: slower. Sneak: you stop.

The remote plays any scene.
notebook.jn1.scenes.2:
THE BAR

Left of the hotbar. It rises during the scene, faster if you join and as the pace quickens.

When full, the scene moves to its finish, then stops.
notebook.jn1.self.1:
MAN OR WOMAN

Asked on your first visit. The Potion of Inversion swaps it: brew a Horny Potion with a fermented spider eye.
notebook.jn1.self.2:
ALONE

The masturbator for a man, a dildo in hand for a woman: hold right-click. An empty bottle in the other hand collects the finish.
notebook.jn1.self.3:
THE HORNY POTION

Brewed: an awkward potion and a poppy. Drink it and choose which girl to become. The heart in the inventory undoes it.
notebook.jn1.cum.1:
THE VIAL

An empty bottle collects a fresh trace. The vial pours on a block, can be drunk or given. Sneaking, pour it on a girl.
notebook.jn1.cum.2:
TRACES

Fresh ones dry in five minutes. Dry ones are picked up by hand.

On the girls, only the shower washes them off.
notebook.jn1.cooking.1:
THE CAULDRON

Pour the vials in. Five minutes later it curdles: empty-handed, one cheese per level.
notebook.jn1.cooking.2:
RECIPES

Any food + dried cum: the same dish "with cum", one more hunger point.

Every recipe is in the recipe book.
notebook.jn1.cooking.3:
OTHER USES

Dried cum alone: white dye.
With string: a lead.
With blaze powder: magma cream.
notebook.jn1.toys.1:
HANDCUFFS

Right-click: cuffed, she stays put. Sneaking: you hold her chain, tie it to a fence. Standing: set free.
notebook.jn1.toys.2:
THE WHIP

A weapon against monsters. On a girl, it doesn't hurt.
notebook.jn1.toys.3:
THE POLE

Three iron ingots. Right-click: she comes to dance. Again: she stops.
notebook.jn1.toys.4:
THE WALL

Right-click one side: she goes to the other. Sneaking, a click stops it.
notebook.jn1.toys.5:
KEEPSAKES

Switching to a lighter outfit makes her drop her underwear. Once a day.
notebook.jn1.toys.6:
THE POGO

Iron, a stick, slime and a dildo. In hand, you bounce. Jump when the bar is full, right before landing: higher, farther. Too early and you lose momentum. Sneak: you stop.
notebook.jn1.machines.1:
THE CUMMY PISTON

A piston and dried cum. An end rod placed on its face becomes a dildo, which it pushes and pulls.

Four dildos in a square: the horse one.
notebook.jn1.machines.2:
AT RANGE

Eight arrows around a vial: they stick and slow down.

Vial + gunpowder: thrown, it splashes.
notebook.jn1.machines.3:
THE CUM JAR

Pour in 69 vials, then a pony figurine (clay, blue dyes). Full, the compressor turns it into a Cum Crystal.
notebook.jn1.machines.4:
THE COMPRESSOR

Hand it a full jar with its figurine. Someone in the void pays well in crystals.
notebook.jn1.shapes.1:
SHAPE POTIONS

Brew a Horny Potion with slime (chest), melon (butt) or bone meal (size); a fermented spider eye turns it down.

Everything goes back one step every three minutes.
notebook.jn1.void.1:
RIFTS

Held above a breach, in the containment sites. Without the suit, the breach contaminates; the shower cleans it, and so does milk.
notebook.jn1.void.2:
THE VOID SUIT

In the site's locker room. Fully worn, you swim:
Jump: up
Sneak: down
Sprint: faster
notebook.jn1.void.3:
THE LIDAR

In the void, one echo per lab. Key H: the 3D view. To leave, dive down.
notebook.jn1.house.1:
THE LIFT

Lift platforms: the moving floor. Crouch-click one to change its look or assemble it with its neighbours. A floor selector by the shaft on each floor powers redstone while the platform is there.
notebook.jn1.house.2:
THE CAMERA

In hand, the viewfinder. On its tripod, with a timer. A print on a frame spreads to neighbouring frames.
notebook.jn1.house.3:
NOTES, SCREENS

Right-click to write, "Lock" to freeze. Wall screens placed side by side become one.

gaster_shop.jn1.title: Gaster
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.0:
* Ah. A visitor.
* These items should never have existed.
* Therefore, they are for sale.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.1:
* You found me.
* Very, very interesting.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.2:
* Do not look behind the tree.
* Look at the merchandise instead.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.3:
* Welcome to a shop that does not exist.
* The prices, however, are very real.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.4:
* Step closer.
* No. Not that close.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.5:
* I was expecting you.
* I am always expecting someone.
* It is exhausting.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.6:
* Another experiment wanders in.
* How delightful.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.7:
* Mind the void.
* It minds you back.
gaster_shop.jn1.accueil.8:
* You smell of the laboratory.
* And of... crystals. Excellent.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.0:
* The crystals? Cum, compressed until pure.
* Science knows no limits. Sadly.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.1:
* The figurine in the jar is essential.
* Do not ask me why.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.2:
* This tree is an excellent observation post.
* You, however, are terrible at hiding.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.3:
* Sixty-nine. No more, no less.
* Some constants are not up for debate.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.4:
* The void is not empty.
* It is merely very, very quiet.
* Listen.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.5:
* I once fell into my own experiment.
* Scattered across time and space.
* I do not recommend it.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.6:
* The girls in the lab call me "the tall one".
* I have decided it is a compliment.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.7:
* FapGPT asked me for a hug once.
* I declined.
* My hands are... complicated.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.8:
* You wonder why I leave an egg.
* You are asking the wrong questions.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.9:
* Dark. Darker. Your house, I mean.
* Place a torch, perhaps.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.10:
* A command block, in your hands.
* The universe sighs a little
  every time I sell one.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.11:
* My face is cracked. Yes.
* It was like this when I found it.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.12:
* Entry number... I forget which.
* I have written too many entries.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.13:
* You wonder why I hide behind trees.
* Trees do not ask questions.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.14:
* Hold a crystal up to the light.
* You will see the pony's tiny face.
* Do not hold it up to the light.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.15:
* I am not a merchant.
* I am a scientist with a surplus.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.16:
* The pony in the jar is blue for a reason.
* The reason is classified.
gaster_shop.jn1.parler.17:
* Somewhere, a spawner has gone missing.
* Not my concern.
gaster_shop.jn1.autre.2:
* Take your time.
* Time is cheap here.
gaster_shop.jn1.merci.1:
* A fine choice.
* A terrible, fine choice.
gaster_shop.jn1.merci.2:
* Do not tell anyone
  where you got it.
gaster_shop.jn1.merci.3:
* Use it wisely.
* Or do not. I will be watching.
gaster_shop.jn1.pauvre.1:

gaster_shop.jn1.deja.0:
